description: This file implements the feature for creating comments within the application. It includes data records, validation, and a request handler that interacts with the database to add a new comment to an article identified by its slug.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the comment body is not empty.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the process of creating a new comment, associating it with an article and the current user, and saving it to the database.

methods.name: Create.CommandValidator..ctor
methods.description: Initializes validation rules for the Command object, ensuring the comment body is not empty.

methods.name: Create.Handler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the creation of a new comment by retrieving the article, author, creating the comment entity, saving changes, and returning the comment envelope.
